title: Placeholder passwords in connection URIs: must not be flagged
summary: Connection URIs whose password is a placeholder such as `your_password_here` or `REPLACE_ME_PASSWORD`. Covers 7 inputs.
rationale: Templates for connection strings are everywhere in documentation. A placeholder in the password position is an instruction to the reader, not a secret.

expectation.rationale: Placeholder, tutorial, reference, template or mask control whose expected silence follows a closed redact-secret issue decision, not a universal secret definition.
